body.displayDescription: Hard Misthalin for Asylum surgeon's ring (Broken Home). User rule 2026-07-26 closes Misthalin/Morytania boundary as Misthalin.
body.name: Asylum surgeon's ring

reason: The infobox lists Armour as None, so the ring carries a sourced zero rather than an unknown. Names its passive - a 10% chance to cut an ability's adrenaline cost by 15%, behind a 30 second cooldown - without modelling it.

The bracelet trades stats for its passive: the infobox lists Armour 0.0 and 0 life points, both sourced zeros. Names the passive - a 20% chance to reflect 25-50% of damage taken, capped at 5000 - without modelling it.
